lines.zh: 风推着我走，天境的路真轻。
lines.en: The wind pushes me along; Aether paths feel light.
Clouds below; I must tread carefully.
Patrolling the Aether, my steps cannot stop.

lines.zh: 这块浮岛，我得多绕两圈。
lines.en: I should circle this floating isle twice more.
Wings folded, walking feels easy too.
Crystal paths are slick; slow down.
Wind ahead; I walk along with it.
The Aether is vast; I patrol slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，光会亮些。
lines.en: Where I walk, the light grows brighter.
Shadow follows me; stay close.

lines.zh: 地下城的入口，我记下了。
lines.en: I noted the dungeon entrance.
Soft steps; don't wake the sleeping.

lines.zh: 云层在脚下散开，继续走。
lines.en: Clouds part beneath my feet; keep walking.
This little path is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 走一圈，看看有没有异样。
lines.en: One round, to check for anything odd.
The wind died down; perhaps I should pause.
The Aether is quiet; I rest a while.
Wings half-spread, I listen to the wind.
The isle drifts; I watch in silence.
Light rests on my shoulder, warm.
No enemies here; I stand for now.
Cloud shadows pass; I blink.

lines.zh: 地下城那边，暂时没动静。
lines.en: The dungeon side is quiet for now.
I guard this sky, still as stone.
Windbell grass rings, so softly.
Resting, but my ears are not.
Crystal glare makes me squint.
So quiet I can hear clouds move.
You've come; I've been watching.
Stranger, state your purpose.
I heard your footsteps.
Don't fear; I'm only looking at you.
The aether wind pushes me along.
Which floating isle are you from?

lines.zh: 我的翅膀挡住浮岛间的风。
lines.en: My wings block the wind between the floating isles.
You don't look like an enemy.
New faces are rare in the Aether.
I've noted your shadow.
That one stung a bit.
I hear my feathers trembling.
Don't celebrate too soon.
The wound will heal; the Aether won't fall.
I grit my teeth and keep watch.
Your strike was quick.
The light dimmed; I'm fine.
Pain aside, my steps stay sure.
Come again; I'll take it.
I step back half a pace, then steady.
I don't eat; put that away.

lines.zh: 食物引不动我，收起来吧。
lines.en: Food won't move me; put it back.
What do you intend with that?
I guard the sky; I'm not greedy.
That trick won't work on me.
Stop waving it; I'm not interested.
Aether spirits don't live on that.

lines.zh: 我守着天境的云，不守你的东西。
lines.en: I guard Aether's clouds, not your things.
Trying to trade food for something? No.
I watch the path, not your hands.
Hey, watch where you're going.
You bumped me; steady yourself.
Don't shove; I'm guarding here.
The cloud path is narrow; make room.
You made my wings twitch.
Easy, I'm not a wall.
I'll remember that bump.
Too close; step back a bit.
Don't charge around the floating isle.
You ruffled my feathers.
I block the wind, not you.
Stand firm before walking; no rush.
You came at me from the right.
Bump again and I'll take notice.
That's not something I do.
Guardians don't speak of such things.
I only guard the Aether.

lines.zh: 天境的守护也需要同伴。
lines.en: Even a sky guardian wants company.
My duty lies elsewhere.
The wind refuses for me.
That's not the way of Aether spirits.
I guard the isle; nothing more.
Please take those words back.
I answer only the call of patrol.

lines.zh: 我不拾取东西，别放我脚边。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; don't drop them at my feet.
Leave these for those who need them.
My hands are only for guarding the Aether.
What falls to the ground, I don't take.
You dropped it; pick it up yourself.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，也没有贪心。
lines.en: I have no pockets and no greed.
This shouldn't belong to me.
Don't push it on me; I can't take it.
Picking things up isn't my duty.
Leave it there; let the wind watch.
Something moves; I've marked you.
That's off; I've got my eye on it.
This salt flat is mine to watch over.

lines.zh: 闯入者，我记住你的位置。
lines.en: Intruder, I've noted your position.
The wind told me you're here.
Target sighted; I'm ready.
You've stepped into my guarded ground.
This area is under my watch.
I see you; don't hide.
Hostility detected; I lock on first.
Don't come closer; I'm watching.

lines.zh: 你的动作，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: I see your every move.
One more step and I won't be gentle.
The wind is behind you; I'm here.
You can't slip past my sight.
I'll count to three; you'd best retreat.
I know the isle's paths better than you.
You go left; my gaze goes left.
Don't try to slip away through the clouds.
I keep watching; I won't blink.
This strike is for the Aether.
Back off; I don't want to strike again.
The wind follows this blow.
You crossed the line; take this.
Don't force my hand.
Wings bring wind; you're the target.
This is a warning, not a beginning.
Stand firm; the next is heavier.
The Aether brooks no intrusion.
I strike only to hold this place.
The Aether's wind has called me here.

lines.zh: 我来了，这片浮岛归我守望。
lines.en: I'm here; this isle is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 翅膀展开，我从云里落下。
lines.en: Wings spread; I descend from the clouds.
Another part of the Aether; patrol begins.
A flash of light; here I stand.
Who calls the guardian?
I wake among the crystals.

lines.zh: 云路之上，多了我的影子。
lines.en: Above the cloud path, my shadow appears.
The Aether needs eyes; I've come.
Where the wind pauses, I arrive.
Flames licked across my wings.

lines.zh: 从高处坠下，我撞在云上。
lines.en: I fell from above and struck the clouds.
I can't catch my breath.
A blast threw me aside.
A shot came from afar.
Magic coils around me, so heavy.
My stomach's empty; so is my strength.
Sky lightning fell upon me.
The ground vanished; I clutch at light.
